name: vigileye-ai-monorepo
description: VigilEye AI — Full-Stack Real-Time Eye Closure Detection & Drowsiness Safety System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run build && cd server && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
